name: Enhance Emotions
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [emotion, mind-affecting]; Level bard 2, cleric/oracle 2, inquisitor 2, mesmerist 2, psychic 2, shaman 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Targets creatures in a 20-ft.-radius spread
Duration concentration, up to 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

This spell exacerbates any emotions the targets may be feeling. Any creature caught in the area may make a Will save to negate the effects. However, any creature may choose to forgo the Will save. An affected creature has any bonus (usually morale) or penalty created by an emotion or fear effect doubled while under the effects of this spell. This includes effects that affect the creature after they are subject to this spell.
